Operations Support Officer (OPF022) Job at Vethan Concepts Group Limited




        
    

        
        Vethan Concepts Group Limited is a dynamic Nigerian conglomerate with a portfolio spanning scientific instrumentation, energy solutions, industrial automation, and event management. Our subsidiaries operate with a shared commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Support Officer (OPF022) 

Job Location: Ogudu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Provide administrative and operational support across daily company activities.
	Coordinate internal processes and ensure smooth workflow between departments.
	Prepare and maintain operational reports, records, and documentation.
	Monitor assigned tasks, timelines, and deliverables to ensure timely completion.
	Liaise with internal teams, vendors, clients and other stakeholders when required.
	Support logistics, procurement and general office operations.
	Identify operational challenges and escalate issues appropriately.
	Assist management with planning, coordination and implementation of operational activities.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and operational standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree/HND in Business Administration, Management, Operations, or a related field.
	2–5 years of relevant work experience in operations, administration, or a similar role.
	Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
	Ability to work independently and effectively within a team.
	Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] and Copy: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Social Media Content Creator",
  "description": "Onyx Beauty Hub is a luxury hair brand that offer wholesale and retail of virgin hair and raw single donor hairs . We offer variety of hair textures, including straight, wavy and curly hairs. Our hairs are carefully sourced and selected from various donors in China,Vietnam,Laos, Cambodia, Philippines, India,Burma,Argentina.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Social Media Content Creator&nbsp;

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Part-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly creative, trend-savvy, and results-driven Social Media Content Creator to create visually compelling content that reflects the sophistication and luxury standards of our brand.
	The ideal candidate must possess exceptional video production and editing skills, understand luxury brand storytelling, and be capable of conceptualizing, scripting, creating, editing, and publishing engaging content across multiple social media platforms.


Key Responsibilities
Content Strategy &amp; Planning:


	Develop creative content ideas aligned with marketing objectives.
	Create and maintain monthly content calendars.
	Research emerging social media trends, formats, and opportunities.
	Generate innovative content concepts that strengthen brand positioning.
	Ensure all content aligns with the brand&#39;s identity and voice.


Content Creation &amp; Production:


	Conceptualize, script, shoot, and edit high-quality video content.
	Produce engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp Business, and other relevant platforms.
	Create product showcases, customer testimonials, transformation videos, behind-the-scenes content, educational content, lifestyle content, promotional campaigns, and brand storytelling content.
	Capture high-quality photos and videos of products, clients, and team activities.


Video Editing &amp; Post-Production:


	Edit videos to premium luxury standards.
	Produce both short-form and long-form content.
	Incorporate captions, transitions, motion graphics, effects, and sound design where appropriate.
	Optimize content for platform-specific performance.
	Maintain consistency in branding, aesthetics, and storytelling.


Script Writing &amp; Storytelling:


	Write compelling scripts, captions, hooks, and content briefs.
	Develop storytelling-driven content that resonates with the target audience.
	Create content that educates, inspires, entertains, and drives conversions.


Social Media Support:


	Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager and Marketing Team.
	Recommend content strategies based on performance insights.
	Monitor content performance and suggest improvements.
	Stay updated on platform algorithms and industry best practices.


Brand Representation:


	Ensure all content reflects the premium positioning of the ONYX brand.
	Maintain exceptional visual standards across all published content.
	Contribute innovative ideas that enhance brand awareness and engagement.


What Success Looks like
Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should:


	Consistently produce luxury-standard content.
	Demonstrate strong creative direction and storytelling ability.
	Increase audience engagement across social platforms.
	Contribute to stronger brand visibility and customer attraction.
	Become a key contributor to ONYX&#39;s digital presence and content excellence.


Requirements


	HND/B.Sc. in Mass Communication, Marketing, Media, Creative Arts, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2&ndash;4 years of experience in content creation, videography, or social media content production.
	Experience within beauty, luxury, fashion, lifestyle, or premium consumer brands is highly preferred.
	Strong portfolio showcasing previous content creation and video editing work.


Key Skills / Competencies:
Technical Skills:


	Advanced video shooting and editing skills.
	Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, and Canva Pro.
	Photoshop proficiency is an added advantage.
	Strong understanding of lighting, composition, framing, and visual storytelling.
	Ability to create platform-optimized content.


Creative Skills:


	Exceptional creativity and originality.
	Strong storytelling and script-writing ability.
	Ability to identify trends and adapt them to luxury branding.
	Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics.


Personal Attributes:


	Highly creative, proactive, and self-motivated.
	Results-oriented with strong time-management skills.
	Passionate about beauty, fashion, luxury, and lifestyle content.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Strong communication and teamwork skills.
	Professional appearance and conduct.


Salary
N200,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Updated CV and Portfolio or links to previous content work to: hronyxhairbynelly@gmail.com&nbsp; using &quot;Social Media Content Creator&quot;&nbsp;&nbsp;as the subject of the email.

Note:&nbsp;


	Gender Preference: Female candidates are preferred due to the nature of the brand and content requirements.
	However, all qualified candidates with the required skills, experience, and portfolio are encouraged to apply.

        Onyx Beauty Hub is a luxury hair brand that offer wholesale and retail of virgin hair and raw single donor hairs . We offer variety of hair textures, including straight, wavy and curly hairs. Our hairs are carefully sourced and selected from various donors in China,Vietnam,Laos, Cambodia, Philippines, India,Burma,Argentina.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Social Media Content Creator 

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Part-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly creative, trend-savvy, and results-driven Social Media Content Creator to create visually compelling content that reflects the sophistication and luxury standards of our brand.
	The ideal candidate must possess exceptional video production and editing skills, understand luxury brand storytelling, and be capable of conceptualizing, scripting, creating, editing, and publishing engaging content across multiple social media platforms.


Key Responsibilities
Content Strategy & Planning:


	Develop creative content ideas aligned with marketing objectives.
	Create and maintain monthly content calendars.
	Research emerging social media trends, formats, and opportunities.
	Generate innovative content concepts that strengthen brand positioning.
	Ensure all content aligns with the brand's identity and voice.


Content Creation & Production:


	Conceptualize, script, shoot, and edit high-quality video content.
	Produce engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp Business, and other relevant platforms.
	Create product showcases, customer testimonials, transformation videos, behind-the-scenes content, educational content, lifestyle content, promotional campaigns, and brand storytelling content.
	Capture high-quality photos and videos of products, clients, and team activities.


Video Editing & Post-Production:


	Edit videos to premium luxury standards.
	Produce both short-form and long-form content.
	Incorporate captions, transitions, motion graphics, effects, and sound design where appropriate.
	Optimize content for platform-specific performance.
	Maintain consistency in branding, aesthetics, and storytelling.


Script Writing & Storytelling:


	Write compelling scripts, captions, hooks, and content briefs.
	Develop storytelling-driven content that resonates with the target audience.
	Create content that educates, inspires, entertains, and drives conversions.


Social Media Support:


	Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager and Marketing Team.
	Recommend content strategies based on performance insights.
	Monitor content performance and suggest improvements.
	Stay updated on platform algorithms and industry best practices.


Brand Representation:


	Ensure all content reflects the premium positioning of the ONYX brand.
	Maintain exceptional visual standards across all published content.
	Contribute innovative ideas that enhance brand awareness and engagement.


What Success Looks like
Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should:


	Consistently produce luxury-standard content.
	Demonstrate strong creative direction and storytelling ability.
	Increase audience engagement across social platforms.
	Contribute to stronger brand visibility and customer attraction.
	Become a key contributor to ONYX's digital presence and content excellence.


Requirements


	HND/B.Sc. in Mass Communication, Marketing, Media, Creative Arts, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in content creation, videography, or social media content production.
	Experience within beauty, luxury, fashion, lifestyle, or premium consumer brands is highly preferred.
	Strong portfolio showcasing previous content creation and video editing work.


Key Skills / Competencies:
Technical Skills:


	Advanced video shooting and editing skills.
	Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, and Canva Pro.
	Photoshop proficiency is an added advantage.
	Strong understanding of lighting, composition, framing, and visual storytelling.
	Ability to create platform-optimized content.


Creative Skills:


	Exceptional creativity and originality.
	Strong storytelling and script-writing ability.
	Ability to identify trends and adapt them to luxury branding.
	Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics.


Personal Attributes:


	Highly creative, proactive, and self-motivated.
	Results-oriented with strong time-management skills.
	Passionate about beauty, fashion, luxury, and lifestyle content.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Strong communication and teamwork skills.
	Professional appearance and conduct.


Salary
N200,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Updated CV and Portfolio or links to previous content work to: [email protected]  using "Social Media Content Creator"  as the subject of the email.

Note: 


	Gender Preference: Female candidates are preferred due to the nature of the brand and content requirements.
	However, all qualified candidates with the required skills, experience, and portfolio are encouraged to apply.

	Must be a graduate (BSc./HND).
